summary: Revised implementation plan for Focus Plan M3E incorporating all user requirements: Material Symbols Rounded with zero emojis, Roboto Flex and Plus Jakarta Sans typography, @material/material-color-utilities dynamic palette, M3E varied shape scale and connected button groups, strict anti-template guidelines, 3-step onboarding, Terms/Privacy policies, Vitest test suites, comprehensive markdown documentation, and an updated phased delivery structure starting with Phase 1a.
